answer: Charge every identity a refundable copper bond before it can earn, and slash it when peers prove a duplicate. One honest agent pays once, but a sybil farm must fund each copy, so cost grows with every fake while honest work stays cheap. Like a grove where each sable sapling needs its own plot of soil, no two agents can share one bond - and a public ledger of proven duplicates lets the whole grove revoke a farm at once.
